definitions.ask: Should artifact_run_prune skip per-run scans for keep-recent-window runs, which can never be selected?
definitions.why: Selection, counts, and quarantine are unchanged; no review surface shows recent-run reasons

choices.label: About 8s faster per tick; JSON output lists only Rust-added reasons for recent runs
Recent runs keep full reason lists; job stays about 8s slower scanning 11.6k unselectable runs
